blocks.text: This file is valuable to your family precisely because it would also be valuable to someone else. Treat it as a map, not a set of keys. Every field in this kit is designed so that a person who finds it cannot transact with it, but a person you have briefed can act on it within a day.

This kit is an organiser, not a legal instrument. It does not transfer assets, it does not override a will, and completing it is not a substitute for a properly drafted will, a trust deed, or up to date nominations. Where this file surfaces a gap, that is the point of it. Bring the gap to your adviser.

blocks.text: Foreign assets and income generally have to be disclosed in Schedule FA by a resident, whether or not any income arose, and the penalties for omission are severe. Separately, US situs assets held directly, including US listed shares held through many international investing platforms, can attract US estate tax above a low threshold for a non resident alien. Both are solvable with structure. Neither is solvable after the fact.

blocks.lead: A nominee is usually not an heir.
blocks.text: Across bank accounts, mutual funds and shares, nomination generally lets the institution release the asset to a named person, who then holds it for the legal heirs under succession law. It is a discharge mechanism, not a transfer of ownership, and insurance is treated differently again. Keeping nominations current is still essential, because it decides who gets access first. Just do not mistake it for a will.

Review standing instructions, SIPs, EMIs and autopay mandates
Confirm health cover for surviving family members continues
Apply for succession certificate or probate only where actually required

blocks.text: There is almost no financial decision in the first month that improves by being made quickly, and several that are difficult to reverse. Claims, transmission and probate all have their own timelines. Sequence them with an adviser rather than in parallel.
